notes.title: Patch 1.14 - new ending
notes.content:
1) New ending added - become top1 streamer! Lategame formulas reworked. Now you can become top1 streamer in the rankings and get the offer from other streaming platform. New game needed.
2) New Achievement added
3) Fixed bugs

notes.title: Patch 1.132
notes.content:
1. Added an option to randomize events in the game. New game needed. Randomization is available in the character creation screen near traits window. Most events except main scenario ones will be randomized, so you can get swatted or robbed much earlier or later.  Features is still tested so if any bugs occur - please make a post on the steam community hub.
2. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Patch 1.12
notes.content:
Added "IRL cooking" event - proc date mid august+ 2014
Added more interaction to the room:
1) You can take out trash
2) You can look after flower
3) Piece of money can spawn in different places in the room.
Added an option to continue the game after 3 years. (Please notice that no new events will proc after this date)

notes.title: Patch 1.11
notes.content:
"Co-op stream" event added - proc date late june+ 2014
"Screamer" events added - new game is necessary (old saves won't start it), procs only in certain conditions
Now you can skip partnership mini-game with "Ask lawyer for help" option
Added sounds to some game events
"Wongo-Bongo prince" event money requirement bug fixed

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
1. Added "Stream festival" event - proc date feb+ 2014
2. Added "Animal Abuse" event - proc date july+ 2013
3. Fixed bug with "Enrage" sound - sound didn't work before
4. Subscribers formulas and buffs reworked. Subscriber count raises more naturally. Viewers response to submode and work with subs more actively now.
5. Work with subs action bug fixed. (Action wasn't available in 1.09 patch)
6. "Modern technologies" trait nerfed. Now it gives 150 technology points. (Was 200)
7. A lot of grammar, punctuation, and misprint errors fixed.
8. Other bugs fixed.

notes.title: Patch 1.091
notes.content:
1. Added "Charity" event. It procs july+ in 2014.
2. Added "Mods Puzzle" event. It procs after you have enough mods for the event.
3. Added logical minigame to the process of signing partnership contract.
4. Added logical minigame to tournament players.
5. Fixed bugs
6. Fixed misprints

notes.title: 1.085 Patch
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34981265/81683774d4b6fbbfd0dfc859a55e865a2c295406.png[/img]

1. Viewers give hints about "Attention allocation" when you fail actions now. For example "noobs" will hint you that playing game and reading chat is equally important for them in "Giving advice" set of actions. While reacts&comments are not that important.
2. "Contract" event added - approximate proc date is june 2014.
3. Scores given by viewers are now generally higher. We found out that scheduled actions didn't give enough score points.
4. Fixed bug when you couldn't click on anything after "offline" events (like ban or parents) until calendar or other event procs.
5. "Followers milestones" event priority is now higher so expect more procs.
6. "Marathon" event cooldown is now slightly higher.
7. "Who's the boss of this gym" event art added. 
8. "Manner Saga" released too often in 2014 - bug fixed
9. Fixed other bugs.
10. Fixed misprints

notes.title: Patch 1.081
notes.content:
"Who's the boss of this gym?" event added approximate proc date is May 2014.
Few bugs fixed

notes.title: Patch 1.08
notes.content:
Thanks to NymN stream and watching other streamers play game about streamers we fix the following:
1. Viewers now clearly show that they don't like ads.
2. Viewers clearly show that they like giveaways.
3. Comments renamed to "Reacts&Comments" so now it's more obvious how this setting works. (Good for making show)
4. Fixed "Get Banned forever" achievement - it was too hard to get banned forever before. Now it's much easier, beware!
5. "Make show" action now relies more on "Acting" skill rather than "Emotionality" stat
6. Added extra tooltip to help new players find out how to schedule actions on certain dates.
7. Fixed misprints
8. Fixed few bugs

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.0 --> 1.0746
notes.content:
1. Remade priorities and proc rate of numerous events, interesting ones should proc with higher chance now.
2. Fixed misprints
3. Fixed hater event bug
4. Submode and "Work with Subs" actions have more impact now.
5. "Make donation stream" when you're out of money is more profitable now.
6. Changed Pyrus raid online spread to look more natural
7. Hire moderators events now proc earlier.
8. Numerous other bugs fixed
